posts.text: We are tracking more than 25 separate attack patterns including Waves 1, 2, and 3. It’s obvious now that multiple different threat actors are actively exploiting the vulnerability.

posts.author: glxyresearch
posts.name: Galaxy Research
posts.text:
Not one stolen coin was created onchain prior to the March 17, 2021 release of the affected Coldcard firmware.

There is NO evidence at this time that this bug affects other signing devices or wallets beyond: Coldcard Mk3, Mk4, Mk5, or Q operating on firmware released after March 17, 2021
